चशाति चशाति, a wrong reading for व-
शाति, q. v.
चषति, इस्, m. eating; killing; decay, infirmity.

चष् चष्, cl. 1. P. A. चषति, -ते, to eat;
to kill, hurt.

चषक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a vessel used for drinking
spirits, a wine glass &c., any drinking-vessel; spirituous
liquor; honey.

चषाल, अस्, अम्, m. n. a wooden ring on the top
of a sacrificial post; an iron ring at the base of the
post; (अस्), m. a hive.
—चषाल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. furnished with a Caṣāla.

चष्ट चष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (past passive part.
fr. चक्ष् ?), spoken, asked.

चष्टान चष्टान, अस्, m., N. of a prince,
(= Τιαστανος ?).

चाष चाष, अस्, m. the blue jay, Coracias
Indica; (according to some) a kingfisher.

चास, अस्, m. the blue jay, Coracias Indica; sugar-
cane.
—चास-वक्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having a face like
that of a jay; (अस्), m., N. of one of the attendants of
Skanda; (आस्), m. pl. a class of demons or evil spirits.
